recognize_zh: 一團大小相當一致的小到中型芽細胞，核圓或略有凹陷、染色質細緻均勻、核仁不明顯，細胞質極少且無顆粒，符合淋巴芽細胞（lymphoblast）的樣貌。
features: Monotonous small to intermediate blasts, roughly 1.5-2 times the size of an erythrocyte
Very high N:C ratio with scant, agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented or irregular nuclear contours
Finely dispersed, homogeneous chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules; cohesive-appearing cluster from a smear
describe_en: Smear shows clusters of monotonous small to intermediate-sized blasts with a very high N:C ratio and scant agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to slightly indented with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods or granules are identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; B-lineage assignment (e.g., CD19, CD10, CD79a, TdT) requires flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; separation requires immunophenotyping (cytoplasmic CD3 versus CD19/CD79a).
Blasts may look identical but are MPO-negative by cytochemistry and express CD13/CD33/CD117 with MPO by flow rather than B-lineage markers.
Cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharp lipid vacuoles and coarser chromatin, and are TdT-negative with surface light chain and MYC rearrangement.
Show a spectrum of maturation with smoother, more condensed chromatin and a normal maturation pattern by flow, and do not form monotonous sheets.
